sources.title: Qwen2.5 - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: The Qwen2.5-72B base model scored 86.1 on MMLU, 62.1 on MATH, and 91.5 on GSM8K, ahead of Qwen2-72B on each and competitive with the Llama-3-405B base model on several tasks despite the large size difference [7].

sources.title: Qwen-2.5-7B: A 7B-Parameter Transformer Model
sources.snippet: Qwen-2.5-7B is a 7-billion-parameter Transformer-based LLM developed as part of the Qwen2 and Qwen2.5 series. It exemplifies the evolution of modern open-weight LLMs, integrating advanced architectural modifications, large-scale multilingual training, and a practical alignment pipeline.
